claims.claim_text: John M Clark has a confirmed match to the exact name and private identifier in the official Army merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The private identifier selects one exact-name record among thirty John M Clark Army rows and dates Army entry to 2 September 1943.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier and exact indexed name are decisive among numerous common-name candidates.
claims.temporal_assessment: The record dates Army entry but does not date OSS service or prove the occupational category was immediately prior.
claims.match_notes: The Army row records an enlisted grade and no branch assignment. No public agency, employer or immediate OSS predecessor is inferred.

claims.claim_text: An official Army-entry record assigns John M Clark the broad occupational category Policemen and detectives, public service; no employing agency or exact role is identified.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The identifier-matched Army row carries occupation value 266, decoded on the visually inspected official NARA code page.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier selects the indexed person from thirty exact-name Army candidates.
claims.temporal_assessment: The code was captured at Army entry on 2 September 1943; whether it was his immediate pre-OSS work is unknown.
claims.match_notes: Occupation remains distinct from employer and self-employment; no organization, jurisdiction, workplace or exact police-versus-detective role is inferred.
